title: Unused schedule model imports fail Ruff lint
reasoning: The configured lint rules include Pyflakes F401, and `python -m ruff check --no-cache app/api/schedules.py` reports both `ScheduleRead` and `ScheduleUpdate` as imported but unused. This makes the repository lint command fail even though the route itself can run.
reproduction: Run `python -m ruff check --no-cache app/api/schedules.py`; Ruff reports F401 for `ScheduleRead` and `ScheduleUpdate` on line 11.
recommendation: Remove the unused `ScheduleRead` and `ScheduleUpdate` imports, or use the existing model types consistently if they are intended to be the public API schemas.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The linked feature has no direct tests, and runtime tests would not catch a static lint failure unless the lint command is run in CI.
minimumFixScope: Edit `app/api/schedules.py` to drop the unused imports and rerun Ruff on the file.
